executiveSummary: Apple's dominance in the smartphone market continues to grow, with AI-powered features gaining traction, while supply chain issues and pricing changes affect various products.

takeaways.title: Apple's growing smartphone market share
takeaways.description: According to 9to5Mac, Apple accounted for 57% of US smartphone shipments in Q3, showcasing its continued dominance in the market. This trend is also reflected in 9to5Mac's report on the best Apple Black Friday deals, highlighting the popularity of Apple products during the holiday season.

takeaways.title: AI-powered features gaining traction
takeaways.description: Readdle's updated Documents app for iPhone and iPad includes AI-powered features like voice recording with transcripts, summaries, and follow-up notes, as mentioned in 9to5Mac's article on the app's update. This trend suggests a growing interest in AI-powered tools for productivity and organization.

takeaways.title: Supply chain issues affecting products
takeaways.description: 9to5Mac reports on the limited stock of AirPods Pro 3, which have been restocked at a discounted price. This highlights the impact of supply chain issues on product availability and pricing.

worthWatching: The Garmin Forerunner 265S is now available at $300, its best price of the year
Netflix's coziest show has made a very quiet return
engineeringPerspective: The use of AI-powered features in productivity apps like Readdle's Documents app highlights the potential for machine learning to enhance user experience.
The limited stock of AirPods Pro 3 and their subsequent restocking at a discounted price demonstrate the impact of supply chain issues on product availability and pricing.
